mapper.select:
SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ as courseSeq , A.TITLE , A.CATEGORY_ID , B.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , A.MAIN_IMG , A.PRICE , A.BADGE , A.INTROD , A.DISPLAY_YN AS displayYn , A.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_COURSE A INNER JOIN TB_CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND B.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}

SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ as courseSeq , A.TITLE , A.CATEGORY_ID , B.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , A.PRICE , A.MAIN_IMG , A.BADGE , A.DISPLAY_YN AS displayYn , A.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_COURSE A INNER JOIN TB_CATEGORY B ON A.CATEGORY_ID = B.CATEGORY_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.REG_DT BETWEEN CAST(CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AS DATETIME) AND CAST(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME)
AND A.TITLE LIKE #{title} + '%'
SELECT A.COURSE_SEQ , A.TITLE , A.CATEGORY_ID , A.PRICE , A.BADGE , A.DISPLAY_YN , A.INTROD , A.MAIN_IMG , A.CONTENT_DETAIL , A.REG_DT FROM TB_COURSE A WHERE A.COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq}

SELECT A.COURSE_DTL_SEQ , A.COURSE_SEQ , A.UNIT_TITLE , A.DISPLAY_YN , A.SORT , A.FILE_SEQ , B.FILE_NAME , B.FILE_URL , B.FILE_SIZE , B.THUMBNAIL_URL FROM TB_COURSE_DETAIL A OUTER APPLY ( SELECT F.FILE_SEQ , F.FILE_NAME , F.FILE_URL , F.FILE_SIZE , F.USE_YN , F.THUMBNAIL_URL FROM TB_FILES F WHERE F.FILE_SEQ = A.FILE_SEQ ) B WHERE A.COURSE_SEQ = #{courseSeq}

SELECT boA.BoNum , boA.BoCate , dbo.GetCodeNm('BoCate', boA.BoCate) AS BoCateNM , boA.Subject , boA.Content , boA.UserId , boA.BoNode.ToString() AS BoNodeText , boA.BoNode.GetAncestor(0).ToString() AS ParentNode , CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), boA.RegDt, 121) AS RegDate , '' AS ImageList FROM dbo.TB_BOARD AS boA WHERE BoNum = #{BoNum}
mapper.insert: {call BOARD_COMMON_INSERT( #{BoNum, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{BoCate, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{BizCode, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{LinqSeq, mode=IN, jdbcType=INTEGER, javaType=int}, #{Subject, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{Content, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserId, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserPwd, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserName, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserEmail, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserHomepage, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserContact, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{UserIp, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string} )}
